lines.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Harrington: No disclosure of Confidential Information is required for personal data, whereas Harrington requires compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: Confidential Information is processed only for the Purpose and in accordance with applicable data protection law.
Better for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: Confidential Information is processed only for the Purpose, whereas Acme requires implementation of reasonable security practices.
Worse for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: Confidential Information is processed only for the Purpose, whereas CloudSpan requires a separate agreement with the Customer for data processing.
